title: Portfolio and Case Studies — Data Requirement
content: Production chatbot knowledge should include verified MoinSystems AI portfolio and case-study records. Each record should contain project name, client or client-safe label, industry, problem, solution delivered, key features, technologies actually used, integrations, measurable outcome when approved for publication, and source URL or source document. No portfolio project, client, result, testimonial, or technology should be invented.

title: Technology Stack — Verification Requirement
content: Production chatbot knowledge should contain only the technologies MoinSystems AI has explicitly approved for public representation. The current knowledge base references technologies such as React, Next.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, Tailwind CSS, Python, Node.js, FastAPI, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, SQLite, n8n, Linux, VPS, Docker, Nginx, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, and SSL/TLS. These should be reviewed and confirmed by the company before being presented as the definitive technology stack.
